questions.stem: A 68-year-old woman presents in the emergency room with dizziness and nystagmus. Examination reveals a loss of pain and temperature sensation over the right side of the face and the left side of the body. The patient exhibits ataxia and intention tremor on the right in both the upper and lower extremities and is unable to perform either the finger-to-nose or heel to shin tasks on the right. In addition, she is hoarse and demonstrates pupillary constriction and drooping of the eyelid on the right. Finally, the right side of her face is drier than the left.
